camera_reach.explanation: AABB distance is a lower bound for these nominal reconstructed objects, not an actual routed length. The thin segment only diagnoses whether the lower-bound shortcut passes through objects. It is not a candidate cable or a cable-clearance check.

LCD_external_FFC_identification.evidence: Vendor CAD left vertical connector, matched to official interface photo; electrical L1, 18 pins. Connector_107 is the panel-internal FPC, not the host connector.

limits: CAM and camera geometry is partly photo-estimated; no MEASURED dimensions.
The reconstructed camera-connector latch does not establish the actual cable exit direction.
FFC widths, thicknesses, permitted bends, insertion depths and strain relief remain unspecified.
130 endpoint positions do not certify any continuous cable shape, slack, clearance or fatigue life.
